room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges all-inclusive; proportionate deduction applies if limit exceeded

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year (whichever lower); Room: 2% SI/day max ₹5,000; ICU: 5% SI/day max ₹10,000; Modern treatments: 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; does not apply if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Only PEDs declared and accepted at proposal covered after 36 months continuous coverage

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, piles, calculi, varicose veins, benign tumours etc.; 48-month list includes joint replacement, osteoarthritis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (childbirth, C-section, miscarriage); ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% increase in SI per claim-free year; max 50% of SI; available on renewal within grace period

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses for 30 days prior to admission for same condition

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses for 60 days from discharge for same condition

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; no 24-hour minimum required for day-care procedures

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (E.ll.3)

ayush.note: Inpatient/day-care AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: Listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Consumables/non-medical items listed in Annexure A List-I are explicitly excluded

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded (E.ll.4); territorial limit is India only

moratorium.note: After 96 continuous months (8 years) of coverage no claim contestable except fraud; enhanced SI has fresh 96-month moratorium on enhanced portion

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly premium mode

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewals or porting; refund within 7 days of request

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity credit

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, domiciliary/OPD, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, substance abuse, war/nuclear

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons mentioned in the policy wording
